## 📋 Pull Request Template Selection

Please select and apply the appropriate template for this Pull Request:

* 🚀 **[Feature Implementation Template](?template=feature.md)**: Use for new vertical slice features, capabilities, or user flows.
* 🏗️ **[Refactoring & Tech Debt Template](?template=refactor.md)**: Use for structural refactoring, FSD extractions, dependency updates, or code cleanups with zero behavioral changes.
* 🐛 **[Bug Fix & RCA Template](?template=bugfix.md)**: Use for defect remediation, regression fixes, or incident hotfixes.

---

### Default Checklist

- [ ] I have selected the appropriate template for this PR (`feature.md`, `refactor.md`, or `bugfix.md`).
- [ ] All code passes `bun run validate` with 100% test coverage and zero architectural or lint warnings.
